subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should the A2UI dashboard bridge wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 to define the canonical browser/embedded action-ingress contract, or should dashboard widgets define a separate action path?
rationale: This choice crosses product direction and a security boundary: the implementation would connect untrusted browser/widget content to trusted Gateway/dashboard action handling, and current main does not yet have the dashboard substrate or canonical browser action sink.

options.title: Sequence After Canvas Ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open, make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 the prerequisite contract, then adapt the dashboard bridge to that approved path.

options.title: Define Dashboard Path Separately
options.body: Let the dashboard plugin own a separate action bridge, accepting the risk of another A2UI ingress contract that must be reviewed for compatibility and security.

options.title: Move Outward
options.body: If bundled dashboard widgets are not a core direction, defer this to an external plugin or ClawHub package once the required APIs exist.

recommendation.title: Sequence After Canvas Ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 the prerequisite contract, then adapt the dashboard bridge to that approved path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main adjacent feature signal through the bundled plugin-tab precedent and overlapping web widget work, making them the best available routing owner for the product/security choice.
